command:
set -euo pipefail
export OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=yes OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp

echo "== GPAW plane-wave DFT on bulk Si, serial and 2-rank (the dft env's primary engine) =="
# ASE builds the Si cell in-code -- zero staging. This is the dft env's own D3 reference
# calculation (PW 200 eV, LDA, 2x2x2 k-points), so the energy is comparable to what
# aarch.science published for this image.
cat > si.py <<'EOF'
from ase.build import bulk
from gpaw import GPAW, PW
from gpaw.mpi import world
si = bulk("Si","diamond",a=5.43)
si.calc = GPAW(mode=PW(200), xc="LDA", kpts=(2,2,2), txt=None)
e = si.get_potential_energy()
if world.rank == 0:
    open("gpaw-%d.txt" % world.size,"w").write("WORLD_SIZE %d\nENERGY %.6f\n" % (world.size, e))
    print("WORLD_SIZE", world.size, "ENERGY %.6f" % e)
EOF
python3 si.py
mpiexec -n 2 python3 si.py

python3 - <<'EOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import re,sys,glob
def parse(f):
    t=open(f).read()
    ws=int(re.search(r"WORLD_SIZE (\d+)",t).group(1))
    en=float(re.search(r"ENERGY (-?\d+\.\d+)",t).group(1))
    return ws,en
ws1,e1=parse("gpaw-1.txt"); ws2,e2=parse("gpaw-2.txt")
fail=[]
def check(l,ok,detail):
    print(f"{l:26s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)
# reference reproduction: aarch.science dft D3 bulk-Si PW/LDA energy
check("energy_serial", abs(e1-(-11.703689))<1e-4, f"{e1:.6f} eV  want -11.703689 +/-1e-4 (dft D3 reference)")
# MPI really ran: gpaw's world communicator > 1 (the serial-gpaw regression guard)
check("mpi_world_size", ws2==2, f"{ws2}  want exactly 2 (gpaw.mpi world > 1, not two serial jobs)")
check("serial_world_size", ws1==1, f"{ws1}  want exactly 1")
# internal cross-validation: serial vs 2-rank total energy
check("serial_eq_2rank", abs(e1-e2)<1e-5, f"|{e1:.6f} - {e2:.6f}| < 1e-5 (parallel == serial)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
EOF
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
